name: Documentation Screenshots
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-16

# Summary
`Documentation\` holds real screenshots taken whenever a page is audited, updated or re-checked, so every claim in a report has a picture behind it. Nothing is overwritten or deleted. Alphalete's part of the folder is covered in the Alphalete notes; this note covers the structure, the tool and the non-Alphalete folders.

# Structure and naming
- Per client: `Summit Plumbing Pros`, `Pipeliners`, `Alphalete`, `Other-unknown`, each with `Capture Log.md` and four subfolders: Screenshot from GSC, from Search Atlast (folder name spelled that way), from Website, from other (tracker, GBP, GA4, Keystone).
- File names: `YYYY-MM-DD_<stage>_<page-or-topic>[_desktop|_mobile].png`. Duplicates get `-2`, `-3`.
- Stages follow the page workflow: baseline, audit, before, after, check (2 to 4 week re-check), tracker.

# Capture tool (`_tools\capture.py`)
- `website` mode: headless Chrome full-page shots at desktop 1440 and mobile 390, logged automatically.
- `add` mode: files an existing screenshot (GSC, Search Atlas, tracker) with client, source, stage, page and reason.
- GSC shots are taken in Kim's signed-in Chrome; the window must be visible.

# Current contents (Oct 22, 2026)
- **Summit Plumbing Pros:** 51 screenshots (10 GSC, 41 website) logged in `Capture Log.md`:
  - Oct 8: after/check shots and GSC numbers for pages rewritten Sep 26 and Oct 3 (sewer line repair Queen Creek and Mesa, tankless water heater installation Queen Creek, water leak detection Apache Junction) plus a baseline of emergency plumbing services (112 of 163 impressions were brand searches). Re-checks due Oct 17, Oct 24 and Oct 31.
  - Oct 9: schema accuracy audit shots (about, home warranty, shower/bath, faucet/toilet, pipe lining Tempe) and after shots of schema fixes and the fixture installation rewrites in Gilbert, Tempe and Apache Junction.
  - Oct 16: before/after of the /plumbing/ page update (services list, Why Choose section), approved by Kim. Several log rows show a broken page path (`C:/Program Files/Git/plumbing/`), a Git Bash path-conversion artifact.
- **Pipeliners** and **Other-unknown:** folders created, no screenshots yet.
